Korean Bilingual Vision System Engineer General Description : 
 
 This position is a diverse group of engineers and scientists working to develop EV battery system techniques using Vision, inspection, and data acquisition equipment. We are seeking a candidate to support the hardware, software, and network infrastructure required for these development operations. 
 The Vision Systems Engineer will support the preventi on of quality issues in advance and maximize output (yield, OEE) by establishing an inspection system, managing inspection equipment maintenance, improving inspection equipment performance, and introducing new equipment. 
 
 Job Responsibility : 
 Perform a stand-alone vision controller by using various inspection logic 

 Perform PC based inspection program developed by the vendor that uses various inspection logic 

 Responsible for incident follow-up, root cause analysis, and documentation 

 Commission vision cameras for 2D/3D part inspection, and process control 

 Train and equip the Quality Team to support vision systems after deployment into production 

 Establish vision systems test plans 

 Document control system and equipment configuration changes 

 Apply inspection method to troubleshoot various statuses (I/O boards, encoder, light controller, modules, and devices) 

 Develop and maintain a good working relationship across all levels in the organization 

 Provide enriched feedback to enhance individual performance 

 Complete all safety training as assigned by the Company 

 Ensure compliance with all E HS safety programs, policies, and procedures 

 
 Requirements : 
 Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (preferred Chemical, Industrial, information system, information science, Manufacturing, Mechanical, or related)

 Industrial Maintenance Journeyman’s certificate or equivalent preferred

 Understanding of Production and Processing equipment 0-5+ Years Industrial Maintenance Experience preferred

 Direct, coordinate, lead, and mentor the activities of team members.

 Experience with the management, maintenance, support, upgrade, and administration of a Microsoft Windows environment 

 Prepares and manages periodic preventive maintenance schedule

 Technician is responsible for keeping the records of all preventive maintenance and troubleshooting works

 Coordinate with outside sources to schedule maintenance for more complex issues

 Ensure work is completed in a safe manner and maintain a safe work environment following all safety requirements

 Prepares and maintains maintenance related documents; daily report and check sheet

 Other equipment maintenance and repair tasks as assigned

 
 Must have the following competencies : 
 Be an analytical thinker/Problem Solver/Decision Maker

 Have excellent time management/Resource management

 Organized planner/Attention to detail

 Results oriented/Takes initiative

 Development of others/Teamwork

 Innovative/Creative

 Build Relationships/Client Focused/Service Minded

 Self-motivated, responsible in work

 Positive mindset and active personality

 Great interpersonal skills/Communicator

 
 Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k)
retirement plan; paid time off, paid sick leave, paid holiday; life, accidental death & dismemberment (AD&D), and long-term disability (LTD) insurance; and optional voluntary life/AD&D coverage. Benefits are subject to eligibility and applicable plan
terms.
 
 Pay scale($56,500 - $59,500) 
 
 
 Why work at BTI?
 
 We’re committed to creating a workplace where employees feel valued, supported, and empowered to grow. Our team benefits from competitive compensation, comprehensive health and wellness offerings, and opportunities for professional development. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and make all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.
 
 We comply with all applicable federal, state, and local employment laws, including those related to fair hiring practices, pay transparency, workplace safety, and reasonable accommodations. We are dedicated to maintaining an inclusive environment where everyone has the opportunity to succeed and contribute meaningfully.
